n3.text: Phone: the 5 tabs fit the bottom bar, so the More sheet goes away. Scroll inside each phone. The tutor button no longer covers content.

why1.text:
WHY each change (Home and Learn)

• Path is Home, Path tab removed: your decision.
• Path shows units as sections; only the current unit is open, the rest open on tap: progressive disclosure (Nielsen Norman Group). Also keeps the content under the path reachable instead of a 12,000px page.
• Side column = the live Path page's own sidebar (Up next, Create your personalized path, Course progress) plus Ways to study: all existing parts, your Nov 4 choice for Ways to study.
• Separate 'In this course' list removed: the path's unit sections show the same units and exam shares. Your rule: no repeated info (Oct 26).
• Stat chips, Free vs Premium cards, FAQ only for non-Premium; FAQ cut to 4: your decision.
• Video lessons and Tools sections, hero, footer: unchanged from live.

• Learn opens on the textbook (Contents sidebar + reading), not a list of topics: a topic list would repeat the path on Home. Your no-repeat rule.
• Glossary and Videos are switches inside Learn: follows from grouping into 5 tabs (your decision; nav research: 5 to 7 top items).
• Share, copy link, print moved into a ⋯ menu: secondary actions belong in an overflow menu, primary ones stay visible (Nielsen Norman Group, overflow menus).
• Inner tabs (Learn, Practice, Tools, Progress) get a smaller version of Home's colored banner, with the cards below overlapping it a little: your decision (Nov 5 comment).

why2.text:
WHY each change (Practice, Tools, Progress)

• One panel: pick what to do (practice set, review, flashcards, exam, free response, justify, cram plan), set it up, start. No separate cards: your decision (Nov 5 comment).
• Every setting is visible, nothing hidden: your decision (Nov 5 comment). Only the exam breakdown (information, not a setting) sits under 'What's in the full exam'.
• Free daily limit shown once: your rule, no repeated info (Oct 26).
• Header: smaller colored banner with cards overlapping a little, same on every inner tab: your decision (Nov 5 comment).

• Tools: Free and Premium groups, Not tried yet, Open kept. Descriptions removed: your decision. Each group sits in a card so it can overlap the banner like the other tabs.

• Progress = Dashboard design F, five questions kept. Q1 points to the path's Up next because Home now owns 'what next' (your path decision + no-repeat rule).

• Header everywhere: dark mode and sound grouped in one settings menu (settings menu pattern, PatternFly guidelines; overflow for secondary actions, NN/g). Course name unchanged.
• Tutor: icon button, because the 'Ask me anything' label covered page content on live (seen on Flashcards and the unit page).
